title: Learning to Interrupt in Language-based Multi-agent Communication
abstract: arXiv:2604.06452v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When a colleague starts explaining something you already understand, you interrupt them. This simple act, a listener taking control of the conversation, is natural in human communication but absent in current verbose LLM multi-agent systems. Current approaches address communication efficiency only from the speaker side, compressing messages before they are sent. We flip the perspective: rather than making speakers more concise, we let listeners decide when they have heard enough. We propose a new communication paradigm in which the listener can interrupt the speaker mid-generation. We find that LLMs, given this ability, are overconfident and interrupt too early before receiving sufficient information. This finding motivates HANDRAISER, a learning method that predicts the right moment to interrupt based on estimated future reward and communication cost. We evaluate our framework on three multi-agent tasks: 2-agent text pictionary, 3-a

translated_title: 在基于语言的多智能体通信中学习打断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.06452v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：当一位同事开始解释你已经理解的内容时，你会打断他们。这个简单的行为——听众掌控对话——在人类交流中很自然，但在当前冗长的LLM多智能体系统中却缺失。现有方法仅从说话者角度解决通信效率问题，在消息发送前进行压缩。我们翻转视角：与其让说话者更简洁，不如让听众决定何时已听到足够信息。我们提出一种新的通信范式，其中听众可以在生成过程中打断说话者。我们发现，LLM在获得此能力后过于自信，会在收到足够信息前过早打断。这一发现促使我们提出HANDRAISER，一种基于估计的未来奖励和通信成本来预测正确打断时刻的学习方法。我们在三个多智能体任务上评估了我们的框架：2智能体文本猜词游戏、3智能体场景。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多智能体通信范式，让听众通过HANDRAISER学习方法智能地打断说话者，以提高通信效率，解决了LLM过度自信导致过早打断的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel communication paradigm for multi-agent systems where listeners can intelligently interrupt speakers via the HANDRAISER learning method, improving communication efficiency while addressing LLM overconfidence in premature interruptions.
